wikipedia.title: Shoshone Hydroelectric Generating Station
wikipedia.extract:
The Shoshone Hydroelectric Generating Station is a hydroelectric power plant on the Colorado River east of Glenwood Springs, Colorado.  In addition to its power output, the water rights the plant uses are among the oldest on the Colorado River, and play a major role in the flow of water to the Western Slope of Colorado.
The Shoshone plant was constructed in the early 1900s, with its turbines installed in 1906 and power generation beginning in 1909.   The plant has a maximum capacity of 15 MW from two 7.5 MW generators driven by two turbines, though typical power output is around 14 MW.
